entities.name: Kolo Meha
entities.description: Pyromancer from Bogardan, a sixth-circle mage on a pilgrimage who joined the Kentsu and later Tetsuo Umezawa.

entities.name: Bogardan
entities.description: Kolo Meha's home, vibrant with red mana.

entities.name: Keldon warhost
entities.description: Warhost that Meha joined and which sold him to Marhault Elsdragon.

entities.name: Kentsu
entities.description: Mercenary force Meha served as demolition expert.

entities.name: Marhault Elsdragon
entities.description: General of the Kentsu to whom Meha was sold.

entities.name: Jorgan Hage
entities.description: Commander who nearly killed Meha, later killed Elsdragon and took his place.

entities.name: Tetsuo Umezawa
entities.description: Planned to attack Emperor Nicol Bolas; trained Meha.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: Emperor of Madara targeted by Tetsuo.

entities.name: Ramses Overdark
entities.description: Imperial regent whose keep Meha destroyed.

entities.name: Empire of Madara
entities.description: Empire Meha and Tetsuo sought to restore order to.

events.summary: The Keldons sell Meha to Marhault Elsdragon and Meha joins the Kentsu.
events.quote: the Keldons sold Meha to Marhault Elsdragon

events.summary: Meha creates a chasm to defend the Kentsu and is nearly killed by Hage.
events.quote: Meha created a chasm to defend the Kentsu

events.summary: Hage kills Elsdragon and Meha leaves to follow Tetsuo Umezawa.
Meha defeats Zalgadib and destroys Ramses Overdark's keep.
Meha completes his pilgrimage and stays with Tetsuo.

relations.note: Trained him in the Tsunami-nito school
relations.quote: Tetsuo trained him in the Tsunami-nito school
